lines.zh: 我在腐朽的甲板上跳着走，爪子发空响。
lines.en: I hop across the rotten deck, claws clicking hollow.

lines.zh: 断翅拖在沙里，我照旧昂着头走。
lines.en: My broken wing drags in the sand; I still march head high.

lines.zh: 三步一啄，我在找埋进沙里的铜扣。
lines.en: Three steps, one peck, hunting a brass buckle in the sand.

lines.zh: 我用一只眼盯着路，另一只早烂了。
lines.en: One eye watches the road; the other rotted out long ago.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了一路，像撒下的碎帆布。
lines.en: I shed feathers the whole way, like scraps of torn sailcloth.

lines.zh: 我沿着沉船的肋骨，侧身挤过去。
lines.en: I squeeze sideways along the ribs of the wreck.

lines.zh: 爪子抓不稳，我就用喙撑着走。
lines.en: When my claws slip, I prop myself up with my beak.

lines.zh: 潮水退时，我踩着湿沙巡一圈。
lines.en: When the tide pulls back, I patrol the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我走得歪，却从不肯落在队伍后头。
lines.en: I walk crooked and still refuse to trail the crew.

lines.zh: 空心的骨头很轻，风一吹就偏。
lines.en: Hollow bones are light, and the wind pushes me off course.

lines.zh: 我绕开活人的影子，先闻了闻盐味。
lines.en: I skirt living shadows and sniff the salt first.

lines.zh: 每走十步，我停下来抖一抖烂羽毛。
lines.en: Every ten steps I stop and shake out the rotten feathers.

lines.zh: 我理着胸口那撮没烂透的红羽。
lines.en: I preen the one red feather that has not rotted through.

lines.zh: 没人的时候，我小声练船长的口头禅。
lines.en: Alone, I quietly rehearse the captain's favorite curse.

lines.zh: 我歪头听海，其实什么也听不见。
lines.en: I tilt my head at the sea and hear nothing at all.

lines.zh: 喉咙里的声音卡了半天，才吐出来。
lines.en: The sound catches in my throat a long while before it comes.

lines.zh: 我啄了啄桅杆，木头还是咸的。
lines.en: I peck the mast; the wood still tastes of salt.

lines.zh: 停在这儿，我数船板上的钉子。
lines.en: Standing here, I count the nails in the deck planks.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进翅膀，假装还是活的。
lines.en: I tuck my head under a wing and pretend to be alive.

lines.zh: 一只苍蝇绕着我飞，我懒得张嘴。
lines.en: A fly circles me, and I cannot be bothered to open my beak.

lines.zh: 我盯着水面，等一个不会来的影子。
lines.en: I stare at the water, waiting for a shadow that never comes.

lines.zh: 我反复磨喙，磨得石头发亮。
lines.en: I grind my beak against a stone until it shines.

lines.zh: 我认得活人的脚步，你的太重了。
lines.en: I know a living step, and yours is far too heavy.

lines.zh: 你身上没有盐味，我有点不习惯。
lines.en: You carry no salt on you, and that unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: I tilt my head and look you over from head to boots.

lines.zh: 你袖口有布条吗？我盯了很久。
lines.en: Any rag on your cuff? I have been staring a while.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，先试了试你的名字。
lines.en: I open my beak and try your name on for size.

lines.zh: 我跳上高处，好让你仰头看我。
lines.en: I hop up high so you have to look up at me.

lines.zh: 你眼睛会动，这比船员有趣。
lines.en: Your eyes move; that is more interesting than the crew.

lines.zh: 我学着你的语调，叫了一声喂。
lines.en: I copy your tone and croak out a hello.

lines.zh: 我盯住你手里的东西，脖子一伸一伸。
lines.en: I fix on what you hold, neck stretching with each look.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你也是标本。
lines.en: Stand still enough and I will take you for another specimen.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走半圈，检查你的鞋。
lines.en: I circle half around you to inspect your boots.

lines.zh: 我咳出一声笑，那声音不太像我。
lines.en: I cough out a laugh that does not sound like mine.

lines.zh: 你眨眼，我也眨，用同一只眼。
lines.en: You blink; I blink back with the one eye I have.

lines.zh: 我歪头问你，船长什么时候回来。
lines.en: I tilt my head and ask when the captain is coming back.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我正在学的话。
lines.en: That blow cut off the phrase I was learning.

lines.zh: 羽毛飞散，我数着自己还剩几根。
lines.en: Feathers scatter, and I count how few are left.

lines.zh: 我疼得叫出声，那声音像人。
lines.en: The pain makes me cry out in a voice like a person's.

lines.zh: 骨头咔了一下，我照样站着。
lines.en: A bone clicks, and I stay standing anyway.

lines.zh: 你的武器带走了我半片翅膀。
lines.en: Your weapon takes half a wing with it.

lines.zh: 我退后两步，再抬头时眼神变了。
lines.en: I back off two steps and look up with different eyes.

lines.zh: 血流不多，我早没多少血了。
lines.en: Not much blood; there was little left in me.

lines.zh: 挨这一下，我记住了你的味道。
lines.en: After that blow, I have your scent memorized.

lines.zh: 我咳出一点沙，又把喙对准你。
lines.en: I cough up sand and level my beak at you again.

lines.zh: 疼是活的才有的，我居然还有。
lines.en: Pain belongs to the living, and somehow I still have it.

lines.zh: 那是船长的核心吗？给我看看。
lines.en: Is that the captain's core? Let me see it.

lines.zh: 你手里晃的要是种子，我就跟你走。
lines.en: If those are seeds you are shaking, I will follow you.

lines.zh: 我闻到铁锈味，脚自己挪过去了。
lines.en: I smell rust, and my feet move before I decide.

lines.zh: 给我一块饼干，我替你说句好话。
lines.en: Give me a biscuit and I will say something kind about you.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的口袋，那里鼓得可疑。
lines.en: I stare at your pocket; it bulges suspiciously.

lines.zh: 你把核心放下，我就放下戒心。
lines.en: Set the core down and I will set down my suspicion.

lines.zh: 我伸喙去够，够不到就跳一下。
lines.en: I stretch my beak for it, then hop when I fall short.

lines.zh: 亮的东西最要命，我忍不住。
lines.en: Shiny things are my ruin, and I cannot help myself.

lines.zh: 你晃一下，我脖子跟着晃三下。
lines.en: You swing it once, and my neck swings three times.

lines.zh: 我装作不在意，其实一直斜眼看。
lines.en: I pretend not to care while watching from the corner of my eye.

lines.zh: 撞到你的膝盖，我踉跄着骂了一句。
lines.en: I hit your knee, stumble, and swear in a dead man's voice.

lines.zh: 我从你脚边挤过，羽毛蹭了你一下。
lines.en: I squeeze past your feet, brushing you with feathers.

lines.zh: 我撞歪了，顺势啄你鞋尖一口。
lines.en: I bounce off you and take a peck at your boot toe.

lines.zh: 你挡路了，我拿头顶了顶你的腿。
lines.en: You are in the way, so I butt my head against your leg.

lines.zh: 撞上时我掉了两根羽毛，算你的。
lines.en: Two feathers fall on impact, and I count them against you.

lines.zh: 我从你肩上滑下来，爪子抓空。
lines.en: I slide off your shoulder, claws closing on nothing.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着站稳，先怪你没让开。
lines.en: I flap myself upright and blame you for not moving.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的断翅，我尖叫着跳开。
lines.en: You step on my broken wing, and I shriek and bolt.

lines.zh: 我撞进你怀里，趁机听了听心跳。
lines.en: I crash into your chest and steal a listen to your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这一下撞得不轻，我的喙都歪了。
lines.en: That was a hard knock; even my beak sits crooked now.

lines.zh: 我这副身子还想着筑巢，真荒唐。
lines.en: This body still wants to build a nest, which is absurd.

lines.zh: 我叼来烂绳和贝壳，摆给伴看。
lines.en: I bring rotten cord and shells and lay them out for her.

lines.zh: 我们互相理毛，理下来的都是灰。
lines.en: We preen each other, and what falls away is only dust.

lines.zh: 她歪头应了一声，声音像我。
lines.en: She tilts her head and answers in a voice like mine.

lines.zh: 两只烂鹦鹉凑在一起，像两块旧帆。
lines.en: Two rotten parrots together, like two scraps of old sail.

lines.zh: 我用喙替她梳开缠住的羽毛。
lines.en: I work my beak through the feathers tangled on her back.

lines.zh: 巢是空的，我们还是守着。
lines.en: The nest is empty, and we guard it anyway.

lines.zh: 我学她的叫法，叫得比她还准。
lines.en: I copy her call and get it more exact than she does.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也没提腐烂的事。
lines.en: We stand side by side and neither mentions the rot.

lines.zh: 她走了，我还在原地重复那句。
lines.en: She leaves, and I stay here repeating that one phrase.

lines.zh: 我叼起一枚铅坠，塞进翅膀底下。
lines.en: I pick up a lead weight and tuck it under my wing.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，我都先收着。
lines.en: Whatever anyone drops, I keep it for safekeeping.

lines.zh: 我把瓶子推来推去，听它响。
lines.en: I roll a bottle back and forth just to hear it clink.

lines.zh: 这枚戒指我戴不上，只能含着。
lines.en: This ring will not fit a claw, so I hold it in my beak.

lines.zh: 我叼起骨头，又嫌它太轻。
lines.en: I lift a bone, then decide it is too light to bother with.

lines.zh: 我偷了船员的扣子，他早不在了。
lines.en: I stole a sailor's button; he has been gone a long time.

lines.zh: 学你说话，也顺手拿走。
lines.en: I'll mimic you and take it too.

lines.zh: 我衔起湿透的信，字都化了。
lines.en: I pick up a soaked letter; the ink has all run.

lines.zh: 我捡到半块镜子，照见自己吓一跳。
lines.en: I find half a mirror and jump at what looks back.

lines.zh: 我藏好宝贝，假装什么都没做。
lines.en: I hide the treasure and pretend I have done nothing.

lines.zh: 那个活物在动，我的喙自己张开了。
lines.en: Something living moves, and my beak opens on its own.

lines.zh: 我盯上你了，因为你太吵。
lines.en: I have picked you, because you make too much noise.

lines.zh: 眼里的东西一挪，我就跟上去。
lines.en: The moment it shifts, I am already following.

lines.zh: 我认准了目标，先叫一声通知同伴。
lines.en: Target chosen; I call once to tell the others.

lines.zh: 你惊动了我的巢，这下别怪我。
lines.en: You disturbed my nest, so do not blame me now.

lines.zh: 我看出你怕了，翅膀先竖起来。
lines.en: I can see the fear, and my wings rise before I do.

lines.zh: 那身皮看着软，啄下去应该容易。
lines.en: That hide looks soft, and the peck should go easy.

lines.zh: 我锁住你的后颈，翅膀半张。
lines.en: I lock onto your nape with my wings half spread.

lines.zh: 这不是饿，是习惯，我改不掉。
lines.en: This is not hunger but habit, and I cannot break it.

lines.zh: 你带着活气，我闻着就烦。
lines.en: You carry the smell of living, and it irritates me.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，眼睛一眨不眨。
lines.en: I crouch low and do not blink once.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶盘旋，先找落点。
lines.en: I circle above your head, picking where to land.

lines.zh: 我听见你喘，就决定了。
lines.en: I hear you breathing hard, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 目标只有一个，别的人我不看。
lines.en: There is one target only; the rest I ignore.

lines.zh: 那个蹲下的，最容易啄。
lines.en: The crouching one is easiest to peck.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，脚尖不出声。
lines.en: I circle you without a sound from my toes.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，我逼你退到墙边。
lines.en: Wings spread, I crowd you back against the wall.

lines.zh: 我叫的是船长的号令，你听不懂。
lines.en: I call the captain's order, which means nothing to you.

lines.zh: 你每动一下，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: Every time you move, I take one step closer.

lines.zh: 我在等你抬手，那一下最好啄。
lines.en: I wait for you to raise a hand; that is the easy peck.

lines.zh: 断翅让我慢，可我从不放弃追。
lines.en: The broken wing slows me, and I never give up the chase.

lines.zh: 我假装要飞走，其实在找角度。
lines.en: I pretend to fly off while hunting for an angle.

lines.zh: 你回头了，我就停在半空看你。
lines.en: You turn, and I hang midair watching you.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，等你岔气。
lines.en: I count your breaths, waiting for one to catch.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面冲过来，喙压得很低。
lines.en: I rush in low, beak pressed close to the ground.

lines.zh: 你举起东西挡，我就换一边。
lines.en: You raise something to block, so I switch sides.

lines.zh: 我的影子先落到你脸上。
lines.en: My shadow lands on your face before I do.

lines.zh: 你不跑，我反倒有点犹豫。
lines.en: You do not run, and that makes me hesitate.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就退进水里了。
lines.en: One more step back and you are in the water.

lines.zh: 我落在栏杆上，比你的眼高。
lines.en: On the rail, I sit above your eyes.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡脸，脖子就空了。
lines.en: Block your face and bare your throat.

lines.zh: 我学你同伴的声音，叫你回头。
lines.en: I mimic your friend; you turn.

lines.zh: 断羽卡在巢里，我不在乎。
lines.en: A broken feather stays in the nest.

lines.zh: 喙凿进你的手背，留下一个洞。
lines.en: My beak digs into your hand and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 我啄了一下，又跳开看你的反应。
lines.en: I peck once, then hop back to watch what you do.

lines.zh: 这一口带着铜锈味，不好吃。
lines.en: That bite tastes of copper rust, and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 我扑上你的肩，爪子和喙一起用。
lines.en: I land on your shoulder and use claws and beak at once.

lines.zh: 血是热的，我愣了一下才继续。
lines.en: The blood is warm, and I freeze a moment before going on.

lines.zh: 我撕开你的袖子，为的是那根线。
lines.en: I tear your sleeve open for the thread along the seam.

lines.zh: 我啄你耳朵，学你喊疼的腔调。
lines.en: I peck your ear and copy the way you yelp.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇在你脸上，我趁乱再啄。
lines.en: My wings beat your face while I peck in the confusion.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到羽毛被拽掉。
lines.en: I hold on until feathers come away with the grip.

lines.zh: 你甩开我，我落地又冲上去。
lines.en: You throw me off; I land and charge again.

lines.zh: 这一击我用了三次力气，才找准。
lines.en: It took three tries of strength before I found the mark.

lines.zh: 我的叫声比伤口更让你难受吧。
lines.en: My cry troubles you more than the wound, does it not?

lines.zh: 我啄完就退，嘴里还叼着东西。
lines.en: I peck and withdraw with something still in my beak.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我追了四步。
lines.en: You back away two steps, and I follow four.

lines.zh: 我啄你的拇指，那根握剑的。
lines.en: I peck the thumb that holds the sword.

lines.zh: 翅骨扇过你的太阳穴。
lines.en: A wing bone whips your temple.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的破舱里钻出来，身上滴着水。
lines.en: I crawl from the wreck's broken hold, dripping water.

lines.zh: 沙子动了动，我抖开羽毛站起来。
lines.en: The sand stirs, and I shake out my feathers and rise.

lines.zh: 潮声里多了一声沙哑的问候。
lines.en: A hoarse greeting joins the sound of the surf.

lines.zh: 我落在一根断桅上，先清了清嗓子。
lines.en: I land on a broken mast and clear my throat first.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的独眼先亮了。
lines.en: In the dark, my single eye lights up first.

lines.zh: 船员的旧骨头堆里，有我一只。
lines.en: Among the crew's old bones, one of them is mine.

lines.zh: 我从浪里上岸，抖落一身盐。
lines.en: I come ashore out of the waves and shake off the salt.

lines.zh: 我出现时，风都带着腐木味。
lines.en: When I appear, even the wind smells of rotten timber.

lines.zh: 有人把船长核心埋了，我就醒了。
lines.en: Someone buried the captain's core, so I woke.

lines.zh: 我拍着半张翅膀，从礁石后升起。
lines.en: Beating one half-wing, I rise from behind the rocks.

lines.zh: 这具躯壳又装回了旧习惯。
lines.en: This shell has put its old habits back on.

lines.zh: 我落地的声音很轻，像掉了一根针。
lines.en: I land as softly as a dropped needle.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我就从货舱底爬出来。
lines.en: Night falls, and I climb up from the bilge.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，从你背后叫了一声。
lines.en: I tilt my head and call out from behind you.

lines.zh: 烧着的羽毛味像烤鱼，真难闻。
lines.en: Burning feathers smell like roast fish, and I hate it.

lines.zh: 落地时我的骨架散了一下，又拼回去。
lines.en: I land, rattle apart, and somehow fit back together.

lines.zh: 水灌进空胸腔，我反倒浮得更稳。
lines.en: Water fills my hollow chest, and I float better for it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，羽毛先于身体落地。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my feathers land before my body.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在身后桅杆上，我笑了。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and sticks in the mast; I laugh.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的羽毛发烫，很不舒服。
lines.en: That light makes my feathers hot, which I do not enjoy.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，可还是觉得空。
lines.en: I do not need to eat, and I still feel empty.

lines.zh: 羽毛焦了，学舌却没停。
lines.en: My feathers are scorched, but I still mimic you.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候，我还在学着喊救命。
lines.en: As I fall, I keep practicing the word for help.
